jobs.occupation: 588485 Test Development Engineer- fixed term (All genders) (Testingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
As a Test Development Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, safety, and reliability of technology that healthcare professionals rely on every day.
Working at the intersection of hardware, software, and manufacturing, you will design and develop automated test solutions that help deliver high-quality medical devices to patients around the world in close collaboration with engineers across R&D, quality and manufacturing.

This is a fixed term position till September 2028

Your role:

- Developing automated production tests for our patient monitoring portfolio in close collaboration with R&D during the product development lifecycle.
- Designing and implementing innovative test solutions, including test hardware, fixtures, instrumentation, and test software.
- Creating test concepts from component and PCB level up to complete manufacturing test systems.
- Analyzing measurement data and continuously optimize test coverage, reliability, and efficiency.
- Validating, verifying, and documenting test systems in compliance with medical device regulations and quality standards.
- Supporting global production sites by maintaining and improving deployed test systems.
- Driving innovation in our test development platform through modern engineering practices, automation, digitalization, and AI-assisted development approaches.

You're the right fit if:

- You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Technical Informatics, or a related engineering discipline.
- You have experience in electronics development, hardware testing, measurement technology, or test system development.
- You possess solid knowledge of analog and digital electronics, signal conditioning, sensor interfaces, and high-speed signals.
- You enjoy working hands-on with measurement equipment and solving complex technical challenges.
- You have programming experience in environments such as Python, Go, LabVIEW, TestStand, or similar technologies.
- You are comfortable using modern AI tools and coding assistants such as GPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or comparable technologies to increase productivity and innovation.
- You communicate effectively in English and German and enjoy working in an international environment.
- You are curious, open-minded, and eager to learn new technologies and methodologies.
- You take ownership, enjoy working independently, and are equally comfortable collaborating within a team.
- Most importantly, you are passionate about engineering and motivated to make a real impact on products that help improve and save lives every day.
- Knowledge of medical device development, FDA regulations, ISO 13485, verification, or validation processes is an advantage but not required.

Compensation & Benefits

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is €93,050.83 – €124,067.77. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations. An entry-level position below this range may be offered if the job requirements are not yet fully met; in this case, the employee will be placed in a lowersalary band. We ensure compliance with internal compensation structures as well as standard market conditions.

This role is eligible for Short Term Incentive, with your rewards linked to individual performance and company results. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision.

Benefits include: 

- Annual leave: 30 days  
- Mobility and devices: subsidized Germany ticket, leasing opportunities for private use (bicycles, cars, smartphones,…) 
- Philips University & Philips in Balance: Wide range of professional training courses and for personal development & Healthcare 
- Philips Pension Fund: Employer-funded pension plan

- Philips MyShop: Discount on Philips products  
- Culture: Informal culture, a paid day for voluntary work, various team/cultural activities (on sustainability, diversity, ...), etc.  

How We Work Together

We believe that we are better together than apart. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly’s operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

- Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
- Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
- Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.
- Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.
- Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.
- Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.
- Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.
- Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.

What we are looking for

- Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.
- Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.
- Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.
- Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.
- Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.
- Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.
- Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.

Useful experience, but not required

- DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.
- Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.
- GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.
- Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.
- Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.

- Mobility and devices: subsidized Germany ticket, leasing opportunities for private use (bicycles, cars, smartphones,…)
- Philips University & Philips in Balance: Wide range of professional training courses and for personal development & Healthcare
- Philips Pension Fund: Employer-funded pension plan
- Philips "Partnerzeit": two paid weeks off after your partner has given birth
- Philips MyShop: Discount on Philips products
- Culture: Informal culture, a paid day for voluntary work, various team/cultural activities (on sustainability, diversity, ...), etc.

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is €103,510.62 – €138,014.16. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations.

This role is eligible for Short Term Incentive, with your rewards linked to individual performance and company results. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision.

How we work together
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.

About Philips

jobs.occupation: Senior Expert ERP Change Management (m/f/d) (ERP-Berater/in - ERP-Consultant)
jobs.description:
Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

Join our global transformation journey and play a key role in the successful implementation of SAP S/4HANA across the organization. As a Senior Expert ERP Change Management (m/f/d), you will develop and execute change and communication strategies that drive adoption, engagement, and sustainable business outcomes. By partnering closely with stakeholders at all levels, you will guide employees, teams, and leaders through complex organizational changes, equipping them with the knowledge, skills, and support needed to embrace new ways of working and ensure the long-term success of our ERP transformation.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

Develop and implement change management strategies aligned with organizational and project objectives to ensure successful adoption throughout all project phases.
Lead global change initiatives across functions, business units, regions, legal entities, and cultures.
Identify, analyze, and engage key stakeholders through structured stakeholder management and leadership alignment activities.
Assess change impacts and define effective change, communication, and engagement measures.
Enable employees, managers, and leaders to adopt changes sustainably through targeted coaching and support.
Develop and execute communication strategies and plans to ensure consistent stakeholder engagement.
Drive people enablement activities for SAP S/4HANA implementations, including training strategy, planning, and execution.
Monitor change readiness and measure the effectiveness of change management activities to ensure intended outcomes are achieved.
Show your expertise

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Psychology, Communications, Sociology, Business Administration, HR, or a related field.
- 5-10 years of experience in Change Management, Organizational Development, or Business Transformation.
- Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and build trust across all levels.
- Proven ability to lead diverse, cross-functional, and international teams through change initiatives.
- Excellent communication, facilitation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
- Experience working in fast-paced, multicultural environments across regions and time zones.
- Hands-on, proactive, and results-oriented mindset.
- Fluent in English; German language skills and Change Management certifications (e.g., Prosci, CCMP) are an advantage.

What we offer you

- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues
- Attractive location: Our location in Stuttgart features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks
- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team
- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working
- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor
- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through EGYM Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in Germany

Contact:

You want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!
For further questions and information, please do not hesitate to contact Gerd Fleischmann via E-Mail at gerd.fleischmann@exyte.net.

Please note that we only consider applications submitted through our application portal. Applications sent via email will not be considered due to data protection regulations.
